intro: Work through it in order. Not everything applies to every family.
obituaryNote: Write and publish it after the service date is set, before the service itself.

items.pronouncement: Get a legal pronouncement of death
items.custody: Contact a funeral home or cremation provider to take custody of the body
items.find-wishes: Find any pre-arranged plans, will, or written final wishes
items.tell-close-family: Tell immediate family and closest friends yourself, by phone or a personal message, before anything public
items.dependents-care: Arrange care for dependents and pets
items.secure-home: Secure the home, mail, and valuables
items.burial-or-cremation: Choose burial or cremation with the funeral home
items.casket-or-urn: Choose a casket or urn, and a plot or niche if needed
items.set-service: Set a date, time, and place for the service, or confirm there will not be one
items.death-certificates: Request several certified copies of the death certificate
items.pallbearers: Choose pallbearers, if you want them
items.viewing-clothing-photo: Choose clothing and a photo for a viewing, if there is one
items.confirm-service-details: Confirm the service date, time, and place with the funeral home
items.write-obituary: Write the obituary and include the service details
items.submit-obituary: Submit the obituary to the newspaper or the funeral home website
items.share-obituary: Share the obituary more widely, by email or social media, once it is published
items.reception: Plan a reception or gathering after the service
items.eulogy: Ask someone to give a eulogy, or prepare one yourself
items.family-transport: Arrange transportation for family, if needed
items.notify-community: Tell their employer, clergy, and community groups
items.notify-banks: Notify banks, credit card companies, and other financial institutions
items.life-insurance-claims: Notify the life insurance company and file claims
items.pension-retirement: Notify pension and retirement plan administrators
items.utilities-housing: Notify utility companies, the landlord, or the mortgage holder
items.cancel-subscriptions: Cancel subscriptions, memberships, and recurring services
items.thank-you-notes: Send thank-you notes for flowers, gifts, and support
items.will-and-probate: Talk to an attorney about the will and probate, if it applies
items.retitle-property: Retitle or transfer shared property, vehicles, and accounts
items.online-accounts: Close or transfer email and social media accounts
items.final-tax-return: File their final income tax return
items.headstone: Order a headstone or grave marker, if you want one
items.follow-up-claims: Follow up on any pending insurance or benefits claims
